# KISS (Keep It Super Simple)

## Purpose

Apply this skill whenever implementing or refactoring code.

## Before Starting

- [ ] Do I understand the simplest solution?
- [ ] Am I solving today's problem only?

## Before Finishing

- [ ] No unnecessary abstractions introduced.
- [ ] No unnecessary design patterns introduced.
- [ ] The implementation is easy to understand.
- [ ] Readability is prioritised over cleverness.
- [ ] The solution could be explained to a new team member in a few minutes.

## Common Mistakes

- Overengineering.
- Premature abstraction.
- Clever code that reduces readability.
- Solving future problems.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] The implementation is as simple as possible while meeting all requirements.
